content: What is the cochlear duct length of specimen ZETA?
Cochlear dimensions of ZETA, run 19ac527c · pipeline v0.1.0 · QC pass_with_warnings

CochleaHub doesn't have a cochlear duct length (CDL) for ZETA. CDL estimation lacks a clinical standard, so CDL is not computed. The dashboard only computes A and B, which CDL formulas build on. I won't calculate a CDL myself from those values.

The inputs CDL formulas use are available. These come from run 19ac527c, pipeline v0.1.0, QC status pass_with_warnings:

| Dimension | ZETA | Published range (Zahara2019) | In range? |
|---|---|---|---|
| A | 8.97 mm | 8.17–9.33 mm | Yes |
| B | 6.81 mm | 5.73–7.50 mm | Yes |
| Height | 4.36 mm | 2.80–3.72 mm | No |

- **Method:** these values are a proxy. CochleaHub uses the oriented bounding box of the scala tympani instead of anatomical landmarks. It is not identical to the landmark method.
- **Out-of-range height:** A value outside the published range is a QC warning (OUT_OF_PUBLISHED_RANGE), not an error.
- **Reference population:** The published ranges come from HRCT of 36 ears of implant candidates aged 2–17. ZETA is a single cadaveric specimen.

Choosing an electrode length is a decision for the treating clinical team. I can explain the method or the literature in more detail if that helps.
